name: RuleEngine::audit_command

test_list.description: The dangerous shell DFA rule reports the destructive command.
A network-to-shell command reports the injection category.
A benign command has no dangerous-shell finding.
Secret category is scanned separately and findings expose only snippet CIDs.
POSIX destructive commands and Windows recursive removals are categorized with benign Windows commands clean.
AWS, private-key and GitHub secret patterns each have a matched case and a nearby benign negative.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: A bounded command string supplied for audit.

output_description: Structured dangerous-command and secret findings with redacted snippets.
